Parliament Monsoon Session to Begin July 20, Key Bills Expected

India's Parliament Monsoon session is scheduled to commence on July 20 and conclude on August 13. The session is expected to address key legislative matters, including potential constitutional amendments and a bill concerning the removal of Chief Ministers and Prime Ministers if they receive over 30 days of jail time. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla announced that a report on Justice Yashwant Varma, who resigned amid impeachment proceedings, will be tabled. Decisions on defections within the TMC and Shiv Sena (UBT) are also anticipated before the session begins.
